tabs.content:
orders | take 10                                              // any 10 rows — the "look first" habit

orders | count                                                // 99,441

orders | summarize n = count() by order_status | order by n desc
                                                              // delivered 96,478 · shipped 1,107 · canceled 625

orders
| where order_status == "delivered"
| where order_purchase_timestamp between (datetime(2018-01-01) .. datetime(2018-12-31 23:59:59))
| count                                                       // 52,783

orders
| where isnotnull(order_delivered_customer_date)
| extend days = (order_delivered_customer_date - order_purchase_timestamp) / 1d
| summarize avg_days = avg(days), n = count()                 // 12.56 days over 96,476 orders

orders
| summarize n = count() by month = startofmonth(order_purchase_timestamp)
| top 3 by n                                                  // Nov 2017 7,544 · Jan 2018 7,269 · Mar 2018 7,211

orders
| join kind=inner customers on customer_id
| summarize n = count() by customer_state
| top 3 by n                                                  // SP 41,746 · RJ 12,852 · MG 11,635

orders
| summarize n = count() by week = bin(order_purchase_timestamp, 7d)
| render timechart                                            // a chart, straight from the query


orders | take 5
// SQL: SELECT TOP 5 * — any 5 rows, no order promised

orders | top 5 by order_purchase_timestamp desc

orders | top 5 by order_purchase_timestamp asc

orders
| extend days_late = datetime_diff('day', order_delivered_customer_date, order_estimated_delivery_date)
| where days_late > 0
| take 5
// extend ADDS a column and keeps every existing one: SELECT *, DATEDIFF(...) AS days_late

orders
| project order_id, order_status, purchased = order_purchase_timestamp,
          year = getyear(order_purchase_timestamp)
| take 5
// project KEEPS ONLY what you list (and can rename or compute): SELECT order_id, …, YEAR(…) AS year

orders | project-away customer_id | take 5
// every column except customer_id

orders | project-rename purchased = order_purchase_timestamp | take 5
// rename one column, keep the rest
